latencyCaveat: Incremental shared-cache timings; not independent cold benchmarks. Node peak is whole-matrix cumulative; native/GPU/mobile peaks are not equivalent.

baseline.timeMeasurement: Model load plus per-candidate execution; shared-load observational timings, not controlled benchmarks; mapping variants reuse recognition so do not sum their times

taxonomyCaveat: Dominant categories are observable stage attribution, not proven pixel-level root causes; alignment false/missing rows are not physical segmentation counts.
